verdicts.originalText: Nefer's Charged Attack is a complex multi-state action: tapping enters a 2.5s 'Slither' rapid-movement state that consumes Stamina, then resolves into either a basic CA release OR (if in Shadow Dance + has Verdant Dew) a 'Phantasm Performance' multi-hit Dendro/Lunar-Bloom CA. The schema renders only the basic CA frames + scaling; Slither, Verdant Dew gate, and Phantasm Performance multi-hit are not modeled (gcsim PR uses ~10 nested helper functions across charge.go to model the action graph). Phantasm Performance has 5 sub-hits at frames [10, 15, 23, 24, 25] (3 'Shade' Lunar-Bloom hits + 2 Nefer Dendro hits) and an extra hit at frame 106 with C6 — none rendered.
verdicts.proposedText: Only the basic Charged Attack is shown. Not modeled: the Slither movement state, and the multi-hit Phantasm Performance CA that replaces it in Shadow Dance while Verdant Dew is available.
verdicts.rationale: Long, curator-facing caveat full of banned tokens (schema, gcsim, charge.go, frame counts) and the character's own name. The real user-facing divergence is narrow: the timeline renders only the basic Charged Attack, while the Slither movement state and the Shadow-Dance/Verdant-Dew-gated multi-hit Phantasm Performance replacement CA are not modeled — both a custom resource and a multi-hit collapse, on the CANNOT list, so rewrite not implementDelete. Hit-composition and frame detail demoted to curator notes.
demotedNotes: The Slither state lasts up to 2.5s and consumes Stamina before the Charged Attack resolves into a basic release.

Phantasm Performance (the Shadow-Dance CA) deals Dendro/Lunar-Bloom DMG with 5 sub-hits (3 'Shade' Lunar-Bloom + 2 Nefer Dendro) at charge-relative frames [10, 15, 23, 24, 25], plus a C6 extra hit at frame 106. gcsim models the full action graph via ~10 nested helper functions in charge.go.

verdicts.rationale: Uses internal identifiers (veil[0], TalentLvl 10) and the discouraged 'the planner does not track' voice. Veil of Falsehood is a custom resource not modeled anywhere in the kit, and no burst DMG-bonus effect is authored (effects: []), so this is a real gap → rewrite, not implementDelete. Compressed to the omission plus the base-case note; the scaling-table source detail is demoted (already captured in existing curator notes).
